imports.name: Person
imports.cypher_query: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n:Person {id: row.id}) SET n += row FINISH;

imports.name: Contract
imports.cypher_query: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n:Contract {id: row.id}) SET n += row FINISH;

imports.name: Operation
imports.cypher_query: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n:Operation {id: row.id}) SET n += row FINISH;

imports.name: IS_LINKED_TO
imports.cypher_query: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (src:Person {id: row.id_source}) MATCH (tgt:Person {id: row.id_target}) OPTIONAL MATCH (src)-[r:IS_LINKED_TO]->(tgt) CALL (src, tgt, r) { WHEN r IS NULL THEN { CREATE (src)-[nr:IS_LINKED_TO]->(tgt) RETURN nr } ELSE { RETURN r AS nr } } FINISH;

imports.name: HAS_OPERATION
imports.cypher_query: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (src:Contract {id: row.id_source}) MATCH (tgt:Operation {id: row.id_target}) OPTIONAL MATCH (src)-[r:HAS_OPERATION]->(tgt) CALL (src, tgt, r) { WHEN r IS NULL THEN { CREATE (src)-[nr:HAS_OPERATION]->(tgt) RETURN nr } ELSE { RETURN r AS nr } } FINISH;
